spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (मलते) 10th cl. (मलयति)
1 To hold.
2 To wear.
3 To stick.

Dirty.
2

Miserly, niggardly.
mn. (-लः-लं)
1 Excretion of the body, as serum, semen, blood, marrow, urine, fæces, earwax, nails, phlegm, tears, rheum, and sweat.
2

Sin.
3

Dirt, filth.
4 Dreg, sediment.
5

Rust.
6

Camphor.
7

Cuttle-fish bone.
f. (-ला)
A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta): see झटामला.
E.
मल to hold or contain, (in the body,) अच् aff., or मृज to cleanse, Uṇādi aff. कल, and the penultimate and final radical rejected.

r. 1st cl. (मल्लते)
To hold, to have.

mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं)
1 Strong, stout, athletic, robust.
2 Best, excellent.
m. (-ल्लः)
1 A wrestler, a boxer, by birth; the offspring of an outcaste Kṣatriya by a Kṣatriya female.
2 A cup or vessel.
3 The cheek and temples, the hemicranium.
4 A kind of fish.
5 The residue of an oblation.
f. (-ल्ला)
1 A woman.
2 Arabian jasmine.
3 Ornamenting the person with coloured unguents.
E.
मल्ल to hold, and aff. अच्.

n. (-लं)
A field.
m. (-लः)
1 A man.
2 A mountain, a barbarian, one of a particular tribe.
3 A country, lying west and south-west of Bengal; Ramghur, &c., or according to WILFORD, Mālbhūm in

Midnapur.
4

A name of VIṢṆU.
f. (-ला)
1 A line, a row.
2 A garland, a string or wreath of flowers.
3 A chaplet of flowers.
4 A string of beads, a rosary. In rhetorical or poetical description, a series or string of epithets, similes, &c.
E.
मा fortune, ला to get or be, aff. अङ् and टाप्; or मा to measure, Uṇādi aff. र, and र changed to ल.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced from dregs or dirt, &c.
n. (-जं)
Pus, matter.
E.
मल as above, and ज born.

n. (-जं)
Black pepper.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Foul, dirty, filthy.
E.
मल dirt, दूषित faulty.

m. (-नः)
A tent.
n. (-नं)
Rubbing, grinding, &c.
E.
मल to hold, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-ङ्की-ङ्किनी-ङ्कि)
Filthy, covered with mud and dirt.
E.
मल, and पङ्क mud, इनि aff.

f. (-पूः)
The opposite-leaved fig tree, (Ficus oppositifolia, Rox.)
E.
मल sin, पू to purify, aff. क्विप्; it is also read with a final consonant, derived from पूर to complete or fill, मलपूर् f. (-पूः) Also मलयू.

m. (-भुक्)
A crow.
E.
मल dirt, and भुज् who eats.

m. (-यः)
1 A mountain or mountainous range, from which the best Sandal wood is brought, answering to the western Ghāts in the peninsula of

India.
2
The country that lies along the Malaya range, or the west coast of the peninsula, Malayālam or

Malabar.
3

A garden.
4 The garden of

INDRA.
5

One of the minor Dvīpas or divisions of the world.
f. (-या)
A plant, commonly Tëori, (Convolvulus turpethum.)
E.
मल to hold or contain (Sandal wood), Uṇādi aff. कयन्.

n. (-यं)
Sandal, the unguent prepared from it.
E.
मलय the mountain whence the wood is brought, and अण् aff.

f. (-नी)
One of DURGĀ'S female attendants.
E.
मलय the mountain, and गन्धिन् fragrant; also मलयवासिनी.

mn. (-जः-जं)
Sandal wood.
E.
मलय the mountain Malaya, and ज produced.

m. (-लः)
The mountain Malaya.
E.
मलय Malaya, and अचल a mountain; also similar compounds, as मलयाद्रि, &c.

m. (-लः)
The southerly wind that prevails in central India during the hot weather.
E.
मलय the Malaya mountain, over which the air is supposed to have blown, and अनिल wind.

f. (-यूः)
The opposite-leaved fig tree.
E.
मल sin, यु to join, aff. क्विप्, and the final made long; also with the final short मलयु, or derived from पूञ्, मलपू.

mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
What conveys or contains soil or filth.
E.
मल, and वाहिन् bearing.

m. (-र्षी)
A sweeper, a cleaner.
E.
मल dirt, fæces, and कृष to draw, with आङ् prefix, and णिनि aff.

f. (-का)
1 A female messenger.
2 A lewd woman.
3 A female elephant.

mf. (-ल्लकः-ल्लिका)
An oil vessel, a vessel made of the shell of a cocoanut for holding oil, whether for culinary purposes or for burning as a lamp.
m. (-कः)
A tooth.
E.
मल्ल to hold, aff. वुन्.

m. (-कः)
The Nimb tree, (Melia azadiracta.)
n. (-कं)
A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.)
f. (-का)
A garland.
E.
माला a garland, कन् aff., and the final of the fem. rejected; also in the fem. form, मालाका and मालिका q. v.

f. (-का)
A garland, a wreath.
E.
माला the same, and कन् pleonasm.

n. (-णं)
Purification, cleaning, cleansing.
E.
मल dirt, excrescence, अपकर्षण removing.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
1 Soiling, dirtying.
2 Defiling, disgracing.
m. (-हः)
Acceptance of forbidden gifts.
E.
मल, and आवह what brings.

f. (-लिः)
Having, possession.
E.
मल to hold, इन् aff.

m. (-ल्लिः)
1 Having, holding.
2 One of the Jinas or Jaina saints, the 19th of the present era.
f. (-ल्लिः-ल्लि)
Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac.)
E.
मल्ल to hold, Uṇādi aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added for the fem.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Dirty, filthy, foul.
2

Black.
3

Vile, bad.
4 Foul, (figuratively,) soiled with crime or vice, sinful, depraved.
n. (-नं)
1

Buttermilk.
2

Fault, defect.
3 Borax.
f. (-नी)
A woman during menstruation.
E.
मल dirt, इनच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Obscured, beclouded.
E.
मलिन, and प्रभा light.

mfn. (-खः-खी-खं)
1 Cruel, fierce, savage.
2 Vile, wicked.
m. (-खः)
1 AGNI or fire.
2 A ghost, a goblin.
3 The black-faced monkey.
E.
मलिन black, and मुख the face.

m. (-म्बुः)
Ink.
E.
मलिन dirty, and अम्बु water.

m. (-स्यः)
A savage, a cruel or ferocious man.
E.
मलिन black, foul, (with fury,) and आस्य the face.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Soiled, defiled.
2 Corrupted, wicked.
E.
मलिन, and इतच् aff.

m. (-चः)
1 A thief.
2 Burning, blazing.
3 Fire, air, wind.
4 The intercalary lunar month, introduced every third year, in order to approximate the lunar, and solar modes of computation.
5 A gnat, a musquito.
6 Frost.
E.
मलि possession, and म्लुच to steal, aff. क.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
1 Very foul or unclean.
2 Very wicked.
f. (-ष्ठा)
A woman during menstruation.
E.
मल unclean, इष्ठन् aff. of the superlative.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
1 Dirty, foul, unclean.
2 Wicked.
m. (-सः)
1

Iron.
2

Green vitriol.
E.
मल dirt, ईमसच् aff.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
1 Very dirty or impure.
2 Very wicked.
E.
मल, and ईयसुन् aff. of the superlative.

m. (-कः)
A kind of worm.
E.
मल dirt, ऊकन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-र्य्यं)
A musical instrument, a drum or trumpet used at athletic contests.
E.
मल्ल a wrestler, and तूर्य्य an instrument of music; it also occurs गन्धतूर्य्यं.

m. (-गः)
1 The elephant of

INDRA.
2
A name of the saint

VĀTSYĀYANA.
2

A letter-carrier.
4 A work on amorous topics by VĀTSYĀYANA Muni.
E.
मल्ल strong, and नाग an elephant.

f. (-भूः)
A palæstrum or arena, a place for athletic contests; it is also applied to the site of any conflict, as a field of battle, &c.
E.
मल्ल a wrestler, and भू earth, place; also मल्लभूमि f. (-मिः).

f. (-चा)
A match of wrestling or boxing.
E.
मल्ल a wrestler, and याचा a festival.

n. (-द्धं)
Wrestling, boxing.
E.
मल्ल a wrestler, and युद्ध contest.

f. (-री)
One of the Rāgiṇīs or divisions of the musical mode Megha.

m. (-कः)
1 A bird, said to be a sort of goose with brown legs and bill.
2 A shuttle.
3 The month Māgha.
f. (-का)
1 Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac.)
2 A kind of fish.
3 An earthen vessel for holding oil, &c.
4 A goblet, a cup, a drinking vessel.
6 A river.
E.
कन् added to मल्लि.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to a garland, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A florist, a flower-gatherer or seller.
2 A sort of bird.
3 A colorist, a painter.
f. (-का)
1 Double jasmine, (Jasminum zambac, floribus multiplicatis.)
2 A daughter.
3 A necklace, an ornament of the neck.
4 A garland of flowers, a wreath.
5 The name of a river.
6 A spirituous or vinous liquor.
7 Linseed, (Linum utilatissimum.)
8 A palace.
E.
माला a garland, ठक् aff., or कन् added, fem. form.

m. (-क्षः)
1 A horse marked with white about the eyes.
2 A sort of goose with brown legs and bill.
E.
मल्लिका the jasmine, and अक्ष the eye, being of like whiteness.

m. (-ष्पः)
Arabian jasmine.
E.
मल्लिका the same, पुष्प a flower.

n. (-न्धिः)
Aloe wood.
E.
मल्लि jasmine, and गन्धि smelling.

n. (-चं)
A mushroom.

m. (-ल्लुः)
A bear.
E.
मल्ल to hold, aff. उ.

m. (-लुः)
A sort of creeper.
E.
मल to hold, Uṇādi aff. उण्.

f. (-ती)
1 Great-flowered jasmine, (Jasminum grandiflorum.)
2 A bud, a blossom.
3 A young woman.
4

Moonlight.
5

Night.
6

A river.
7 A flower, (Bignonia suaveolens.)
8 A shrub, (Echites caryophyllata.)
9 A species of the Jagatī metre.
E.
मा LAKṢMĪ, लत Sautra root, to shake, aff. अच् and ङीप्; or मल to hold, अतच् aff.; or माल VIṢṆU, अत to go, (to be presented to,) aff. अण् and ङीष्.

m. (-जः)
Borax.
E.
मालती the river, तीर the bank, and ज produced.

m. (-वः)
The province of Malva, or
m. plu. (-वाः)
The people of that province; also with ञ्य pleonasm मालव्य, fem. मालवी.

f. (-सी)
A plant, commonly Keśapuṣṭa.

m. (-रः)
A flower-seller, a florist, a gardener.
E.
माला a garland, and कार who makes; also मालाकृत्, &c.

m. (-कः)
A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schoenanthus.)
E.
माला a wreath, तृण grass, and कन् added.

n. (-कं)
In rhetoric, affinity of various objects, by a common property.
E.
माला, and दीपक illustrating.

n. (-लं)
The seed of the Eleocarpus, of which common rosaries, are made.
E.
माला a rosary, and फल fruit.

m. (-ली)
A florist, a gatherer and vender of flowers, a gardener.
f. (-लिनी)
1 A name of UMĀ or

DURGĀ.
2

The Ganges of heaven.
3 The city Campā, the modern

Bhāgalpur.
4

A poetical stanza, consisting of alternate verses or hemistichs of eight and seven syllables; it is especially used to conclude a section or canto.
5 The wife of a flower-gatherer, or a female vender of garlands, &c.
6 A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.)
7 A shrub, (Echites caryophyllata.)
E.
माला a garland, इनि aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.

m. (-नः)
1 A variegated snake.
2 One of the Nāgas or serpents of Pātāla (?)
f. (-नी)
A sort of creeper.
E.
मालु a creeper, and धान having.

m. (-रः)
A fruit tree, (Ægle marmelos.)
E.
मा fortune, लू to cut, and रक् aff., form irr.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Relating to a garland, &c.
f. (-या)
Large cardamoms.
E.
माला, and ढक् aff.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Proper or fit for a garland, &c.
n. (-ल्यं)
1 A flower.
2 A garland, a wreath.
3 A chaplet, a garland for the forehead.
f. (-ल्या)
A sort of grass, (Trigonella corniculata.)
E.
माला a garland, and यत् aff.

m. (-वान्)
A mountainous range, described as one of the smaller mountains of India proper; lying eastward of mount Meru.
f. (-वता)
Name of a river.
E.
माल्य a wreath, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-वी)
A wrestling or boxing match.
